chapter: Opening, St. Catharines Hall and the Odd Fellows
title: What dances at St. Catharines Hall were like
summary: Dances were occasional, ticketed, with soft drinks and sandwiches but no liquor, under Father Moe; the bands played Dixieland and occasionally hymns.
